# Modbus Poll 9.2.2 格式对照

来源：本机 64 位 Build 1343，逐个新建窗口、选择格式并另存；HMT_pH 为用户原始文件的副本。

字序后缀：0=Big-endian，1=Little-endian，2=Big-endian byte swap，3=Little-endian byte swap。
对应 ValueCodec.Order 分别为 0、3、2、1。

| 样例 | MBP 编号 |
|---|---|
| binary16.mbp | 3 |
| double64-0.mbp | 7 |
| double64-1.mbp | 12 |
| double64-2.mbp | 13 |
| double64-3.mbp | 6 |
| float32-0.mbp | 5 |
| float32-1.mbp | 10 |
| float32-2.mbp | 11 |
| float32-3.mbp | 4 |
| hex16.mbp | 2 |
| signed16.mbp | 0 |
| signed32-0.mbp | 9 |
| signed32-1.mbp | 14 |
| signed32-2.mbp | 15 |
| signed32-3.mbp | 8 |
| signed64-0.mbp | 21 |
| signed64-1.mbp | 24 |
| signed64-2.mbp | 23 |
| signed64-3.mbp | 22 |
| unsigned16.mbp | 1 |
| unsigned32-0.mbp | 17 |
| unsigned32-1.mbp | 20 |
| unsigned32-2.mbp | 19 |
| unsigned32-3.mbp | 18 |
| unsigned64-0.mbp | 25 |
| unsigned64-1.mbp | 28 |
| unsigned64-2.mbp | 27 |
| unsigned64-3.mbp | 26 |
